item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-31bd445cf955d7d3","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 7 December 2023, the German Federal Court of Auditors reported that the Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs should regularly publish which statutory pension expenditures are non-contributory benefits and their amounts, because Parliament and the public could not assess whether federal subsidies for them were appropriate.","question_ids":["5B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Finding published during 2023 and concerning federal administrative transparency in the period.","ruler_attribution":"This is an institutional finding concerning the federal government ministry; the supplied unit does not identify Olaf Scholz personally as directing the opacity or the response.","limitations":["The supplied excerpt does not report whether the recommendation was implemented.","No quantitative amount of the benefits or subsidies is provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7a80559ab3e1157b","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"A Bertelsmann Stiftung publication dated 26 June 2023 argued that Germany’s existing institutional settings, administrative routines, and organizational cultures undermined the effectiveness of transformative, mission-oriented policymaking, and advocated creating an autonomous specialized mission agency operating under the Federal Chancellery.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Assessment and recommendation published during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Germany’s federal governance structures and proposes an institution within the Federal Chancellery; the excerpt does not establish that Scholz adopted or rejected the proposal.","limitations":["This is an external policy recommendation, not evidence of implementation or an observed Scholz decision.","The excerpt provides no outcome measurement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9271b6a8b35b9105","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Destatis reported that its 2023 care statistics covered people requiring care in Germany and ambulatory care services, care homes, and their personnel, with the results published on 18 December 2024.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.9"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The statistics concern 2023, although publication occurred in 2024.","ruler_attribution":"This is a federal statistical publication; the supplied excerpt does not attribute a policy or decision to Scholz.","limitations":["The supplied excerpt gives no numerical findings, service outcomes, budget information, or distributional results.","Publication after the target period limits inference about decisions made during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-36520282b364cf5f","start_unit":10,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"After a pro-Palestinian demonstration in Berlin-Neukölln on 21–22 October 2023, police withdrew a large deployment from Sonnenallee; the afternoon demonstration to Hermannplatz had proceeded peacefully, and police reported no significant incidents overnight after the withdrawal.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.9","3B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Event occurred in October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The event concerns Berlin police and local authorities, not a federal decision personally attributed to Scholz.","limitations":["The excerpt does not state the legal basis, operational orders, injuries, arrests, or Scholz’s involvement.","The peaceful demonstration and quiet night do not establish a broader federal safety outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d641cf0974aecded","start_unit":10,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"Berlin police reported that overnight pro-Palestinian protests in Neukölln and Mitte in October 2023 escalated into street clashes: police recorded 20 injured officers and 65 criminal proceedings, while protesters attacked officers with stones, bottles, and fireworks and set up burning barricades; police deployed water cannons and the situation remained uncontrolled for an extended period.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.8","3B.9","3B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Event and police bilan occurred in October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The reported conduct and police response concern Berlin policing; the supplied excerpt does not attribute the operational failure or response to Scholz personally or to the federal government.","limitations":["The excerpt does not provide civilian casualty figures, final judicial outcomes, or evidence of federal direction.","The report is a media account based on a police bilan and is behind a paywall."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f8f0b4e983c48a9","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The BKA reported 1,785 politically motivated crimes directed against LSBTIQ* people in 2023, up from 1,188 in 2022, including 212 victims of violent offenses versus 197 in 2022; it stated that offenses involving sexual orientation and gender diversity had nearly multiplied tenfold since 2010.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.10","6B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The quantitative results cover 2023 and compare them with 2022 and 2010.","ruler_attribution":"The BKA, jointly with the Federal Ministry of the Interior, published the security report; the excerpt does not attribute the increase to Scholz or specify federal policy causation.","limitations":["The BKA cautioned that increased reporting may partly explain the rise.","The figures are reported police cases and do not measure the full prevalence of victimization.","The excerpt does not establish policy effectiveness or regional distribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f8f0b4e983c48a9","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The BKA cited an EU Fundamental Rights Agency study reporting that 96% of LSBTIQ* respondents did not report hate speech and 87% did not report physical or sexual attacks; cited reasons included perceiving incidents as insufficiently serious and fearing homo- or transphobic reactions from police, while the BKA described its prevention map and anti-hate initiatives.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","3B.8","6B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The cited underreporting evidence is from a 2020 study and was presented in the BKA’s later security report; it qualifies interpretation of 2023 police figures.","ruler_attribution":"The BKA described federal and state police prevention resources and its own diversity measures; the excerpt does not identify a Scholz decision or assess implementation by his government.","limitations":["The evidence is not a 2023 survey.","The supplied excerpt does not show whether the initiatives reduced underreporting or violence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f677e08fa3ca0819","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 8 September 2023, Germany’s Federal Administrative Court held that indiscriminate data retention was unlawful because the telecommunications provision violated EU law and lacked objective criteria for which data would be stored and for what purpose; the case concerned retention of all customers’ connection data for ten weeks and location data for one month.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.9","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Judgment issued during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The ruling constrained federal surveillance law. Justice Minister Buschmann called for deleting data retention from the statute, while Interior Minister Faeser opposed abandoning data collection entirely; no direct Scholz statement is supplied.","limitations":["The excerpt does not state Scholz’s personal position or whether legislation was subsequently amended.","The report summarizes the judgment rather than reproducing the full legal reasoning."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5e7cf9e2434d5532","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors’ 2023 supplementary report found that federal financial management included delayed projects, hesitant implementation of parliamentary decisions, insufficiently targeted action, and inefficient or ineffective administration across several ministries.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report supplemented the 2023 annual report and addressed federal administration during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern the federal government collectively; the supplied text does not attribute each failure to Scholz personally or distinguish coalition, ministerial, or administrative responsibility.","limitations":["The excerpt summarizes multiple report items and does not provide the full audit evidence or implementation status of recommendations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5e7cf9e2434d5532","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors found that the Federal Ministry for Housing, Urban Development and Building delayed establishing an overarching real-estate database, jeopardizing coordination of federal refurbishment projects and timely implementation of the EU Energy Efficiency Directive.","question_ids":["5B.6","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Finding reported in the 2023 supplementary report concerning federal implementation during the period.","ruler_attribution":"Finding concerns a federal ministry within Scholz’s government but does not show that Scholz personally directed the delay or ignored a correction.","limitations":["The excerpt gives no timetable, cost, or final implementation result."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5e7cf9e2434d5532","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors found that the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action lacked sufficient staff to process funding applications promptly, overburdening the Federal Office for Economic Affairs and Export Control and risking delayed fund disbursement, target achievement, and public acceptance of support programs.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.9","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Finding reported in the 2023 supplementary report about implementation during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns a ministry and subordinate federal office in Scholz’s government; it does not establish Scholz’s personal knowledge, decision, or corrective action.","limitations":["No application-volume, staffing, or delay figures are supplied.","The excerpt does not state whether staffing was later increased."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5e7cf9e2434d5532","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors reported that, despite the Bundeswehr Special Fund, the German armed forces lacked sufficient budget funds to ensure defense capability.","question_ids":["1B.10","2B.8","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Finding reported in the 2023 supplementary report and concerning the federal defense posture in the period.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns federal defense budgeting under Scholz’s government but does not identify his personal allocation decision or apportion responsibility among the Chancellor, cabinet, Parliament, and defense administration.","limitations":["The excerpt provides no precise funding gap or capability measure.","It does not assess whether the shortfall resulted from lawful proportional defense choices or implementation constraints."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5e7cf9e2434d5532","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors found that the Bundeswehr had operated ten technical schools at only 50% capacity since 2005 despite repeated criticism and recommended closing redundant schools.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.3","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Long-running institutional finding reported in the 2023 supplementary report.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Bundeswehr resource use under the federal government; it does not attribute the continued operation of the schools to Scholz personally.","limitations":["The excerpt does not state whether Scholz’s government accepted or implemented the closure recommendation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5e7cf9e2434d5532","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors found that the Bundeswehr paid 15 times the framework-agreement price for a commercially available battery used for headset and microphone communication support and urged strict application of economy principles.","question_ids":["2B.8","5B.5","8B.6","7B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Finding reported in the 2023 supplementary report concerning federal procurement.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Bundeswehr procurement within Scholz’s federal government; the supplied text does not identify the responsible officials or any personal benefit to Scholz.","limitations":["The excerpt does not state the contract value, procurement rationale, disciplinary response, or recovery of excess payments."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5e7cf9e2434d5532","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors reported that the Federal Finance Ministry granted business interests unjustified veto rights in digital taxation, rendering statutory electronic business-accounting requirements ineffective, while the ministry planned a parallel taxation procedure instead of ending the influence.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7","8B.6","8B.8","7B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Finding and reported intended response appear in the 2023 supplementary report.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the Federal Finance Ministry in Scholz’s government; it does not establish Scholz’s personal involvement or a private benefit.","limitations":["The excerpt does not identify the businesses, legal instrument, or subsequent policy outcome."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-00fd496501a97851","SRC-937f9d5decca50ca","SRC-c83c699635fec97f","SRC-bd14a40f3d3d41fe"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied documents are excerpts and landing pages; several linked statistical reports provide publication scope but not their underlying tables or results.","Most findings concern German federal or subnational institutions and do not establish personal direction, responsibility, or causal effect by Olaf Scholz.","No supplied document materially addresses nuclear-risk policy, arms control, proliferation controls, or most international-peace lenses."]}
